## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与业务流程）

### 1. 财务数据

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | YoY (GAAP) | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $37,847M | $33,112M | **+14%** | press_release.txt / financial_statements.txt |
| 经营成本 | $6,989M | $6,042M | **+15.7%** | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $8,958M | $8,077M | **+10.9%** | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润 | $21,900M | $18,993M | **+15.3%** | financial_statements.txt |
| 经营利润率 | **58.0%** | 57.4% | +0.6pp | transcript.txt Amy Hood 段："operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%" |

**分部全年对比：** FY26 收入 $139,996M vs FY25 $120,810M（+15.9%），FY26 经营利润 $83,879M vs FY25 $69,773M（+20.2%）。

### 2. 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

**M365 Commercial cloud：** "M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% when adjusted for the prior year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. On a reported basis, Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 14%."（press_release.txt Business Highlights 段）。电话会中 Amy Hood 进一步说明："net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter. And paid M365 Commercial seats grew 6% year-over-year with installed base expansion across all customer segments, though primarily in our small and medium business and frontline worker offerings."（transcript.txt）

**M365 Consumer cloud：** "Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue increased 24% (up 22% in constant currency)"（press_release.txt）。电话会："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."（transcript.txt）

**LinkedIn：** "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% (up 10% in constant currency)"（press_release.txt）。电话会："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."（transcript.txt）

**Dynamics 365：** "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% (up 12% in constant currency)"（press_release.txt）。电话会："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."（transcript.txt）

**分部整体利润率扩张原因：** 分部毛利率上升 14%（美元），但毛利率百分比因 M365 Copilot 使用增加带来的产品质量投入而小幅下降；经营费用增长 11%，主因共享 R&D 投资（transcript.txt）。

## 三、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 1. 财务数据

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | YoY (GAAP) | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | $39,306M | $29,878M | **+32%** | press_release.txt / financial_statements.txt |
| 经营成本 | $16,876M | $11,845M | **+42.5%** | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $6,475M | $5,893M | **+9.9%** | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润 | $15,955M | $12,140M | **+31.4%** | financial_statements.txt |
| 经营利润率 | **41.0%** | 40.6% | +0.4pp | transcript.txt："operating margins…were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%" |

**分部全年对比：** FY26 收入 $137,791M vs FY25 $106,265M（+29.7%），FY26 经营利润 $56,972M vs FY25 $44,589M（+27.8%）。

### 2. 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

**Azure：** "Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%"（press_release.txt）。电话会："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."（transcript.txt）

**On-premises server：** "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."（transcript.txt）

**毛利率下降原因：** "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."（transcript.txt）

**经营费用：** "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."（transcript.txt）

**利润率稳定：** 尽管收入高速增长，经营利润率基本持平，反映 Azure 规模效应被 AI 基础设施投入抵消（transcript.txt）。

### 2. 下滑驱动因素（引用原文）

**Windows OEM and Devices：** "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7%"（press_release.txt）。电话会："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. **XBOX：** "XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10%"（press_release.txt）。电话会："In XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."（transcript.txt）。Satya Nadella 在电话会中明确："When it comes to XBOX, we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth… and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."（transcript.txt）

**Search advertising：** "Search advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 10% (up 9% in constant currency)"（press_release.txt）。电话会："Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."（transcript.txt）

**毛利率提升：** "Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."（transcript.txt）

**经营费用上升：** "Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."（transcript.txt）

## 七、口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部间收入可直接比较**：三个分部按业务性质划分（生产力、云、个人设备），收入口径为对外确认收入，包含产品与服务。

2. **经营利润率不可直接跨分部比较**：
   - P&BP 经营利润率 58% 包含大量 SaaS 高毛利业务（M365、LinkedIn、Dynamics 365），其成本结构以服务为主；
   - IC 经营利润率 41% 包含 Azure（高毛利但高资本投入）和 on-premises server（毛利率较低）；
   - MPC 经营利润率 21% 包含硬件（Windows OEM/XBOX）业务，毛利率天然较低，且 Activision 收购摊销正在下降。
   - 因此，**58% vs 21% 的差距反映业务本质差异，而非效率高低**。

3. **增长口径差异**：
   - press_release.txt 同时给出 GAAP 和 Constant Currency 增速（FY26 Q4 整体 +18% GAAP / +17% CC）。
   - 分部收入在 press_release.txt 仅列出 GAAP 增速，transcript.txt 中 Amy Hood 会补充 constant currency 数字（如 IC +31% CC）。
   - **Metrics.txt 中的增长率为 GAAP% / Constant Currency% 双列**，使用时需确认引用口径。

4. **成本与费用的分部归属**：本报告使用的 cost of revenue 与 operating expenses 系 Microsoft 内部分部映射（Segment Results 工作表），与 GAAP 利润表中的 total cost of revenue / total OpEx 是从顶向下分配的，**分部成本与费用之和不等于全公司对应项的精确分解**（因存在跨分部分摊项），但**收入、经营利润勾稽无误**。

5. **OpenAI 投资影响**：本季度 OpenAI 投资产生净收益 $480M（影响净利润和 EPS，但不影响分部收入/利润）。non-GAAP 口径剔除此影响，主要用于 EPS 和净利润的可比性分析。

6. **季度 vs 全年**：本报告聚焦 Q4 FY26（三个月）。全年数据见 financial_statements.txt Segment Results 工作表 FY26 列，可用于趋势校验。

7. **XBOX 减值与重组**：本季度 MPC 经营费用中包含 XBOX impairment charges，具体金额未单独披露，但属于影响 MPC 经营利润同比下滑 14% 的因素之一（transcript.txt）。

8. **Activision 摊销**：MPC 毛利率百分比上升归因于 Activision 收购摊销下降（transcript.txt），属于一次性会计影响而非经营性改善。
